title: Foundations: Bits and Thinking
summary: What computer science is, how everything becomes bits, and your first programs in Scratch: the ideas of every language, without the syntax.

title: The C Language
summary: Source code to machine code. Variables, conditionals, loops, functions, then arrays, strings and command-line arguments. You start writing real programs.

title: Algorithms, Memory and Data Structures
summary: Searching, sorting and Big O; pointers, the heap and hexadecimal; linked lists, hash tables and trees. The part of the course that makes you a real programmer.

title: Python, AI and Data
summary: The same ideas in Python in a tenth of the lines; how machine learning and large language models actually work; and SQL, the language of data.

title: The Web and the Internet
summary: HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the browser; then what happens between your laptop and a server: IP, TCP, DNS, HTTP, and how to stay safe.

title: Humans, Systems and Your Project
summary: Human-computer interaction and how software is built in industry, then demo day: your project, live, from your own repository.
